source.title: 2021 Census Forward Sortation Area Boundary File
source.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada. Source: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census Forward Sortation Area Boundary File. Derived area centroids; this is not an official Statistics Canada product.
source.method: Official polygons generalized by the service with maxAllowableOffset=10 metres; signed polygon area centroid in EPSG:3347 including holes and all parts; inverse ellipsoidal Lambert conformal conic; rounded to 6 decimal places.
